Municipality
              of
     Anchorage


     P.O Box 390                  GIRDWOOD VALLEY SERVICE AREA BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
      Girdwood, Alaska 99587                               Jennifer Wingard & Kellie Okonek, Co-Chairs
      http://www.muni.org/gbos                             Brian Burnett, Amanda Tuttle, Nick Crews
    Suzanne LaFrance, Mayor
                              Sept 30 2026
            GBOS Special Meeting: Rules and Procedures &
                GVSA Non-Profit Recreation Grants*
                              Minutes Draft
        12:00 p.m. via Microsoft Teams & Girdwood Community Room

This hybrid meeting is taking place via Microsoft Teams & at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd:

The Girdwood Board of Supervisors is subject to the Alaska Open Meetings Act as found in Alaska Statute 44.62.310
and Anchorage Municipal Code1.25 - Public Meetings.
The Girdwood Board of Supervisors operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order 12:00 p.m. Jennifer Wingard, Co-Chair

Land Acknowledgement: The Girdwood Board of Supervisors acknowledges the indigenous peoples of Alaska, whose land we
reside on. The community of Girdwood, situated between the areas known to be Dena'ina and Alutiiq homeland, respects the people
who were stewards of this land for generations. We commit to the continued stewardship of this land and are grateful to be part of a
wider community that seeks to maintain a sustainable use of Girdwood Valley for present and future peoples.

Attending are: Amanda Tuttle (AT), Nick Crews (NC), Kellie Okonek (KO), Jennifer Wingard (JW)
Brian Burnett (BB) joined at 12:40

Disclosures: Previously discussed and found not to require recusal.

Announcements:
    •   Girdwood Trails Committee plans to apply for a Recreational Trails Program Grant to work on the Beaver Pond
         Trail. Comments are requested by Oct 30 to be included in the application. See meeting packet for additional
        information.

Agenda Revisions and Approval:   September 30 2026 GBOS Work Session agenda approved

Business:
    1. GBOS Bylaws revisions (Wingard/Crews): Group reviews Rules and Procedures that Jennifer and Nick have been working.
         Motion:
      GBOS moves to approve suggested amendments to Section I.
        Motion by KO/2nd NC
        Motion carries 3-1 in roll call vote ((AT Dissenting; BB not attending meeting yet)

*Note: This meeting was originally posted as a work session and has been changed to a Special Meeting.

           GBOS Meeting Agendas and minutes are available on line: http://www.muni.org/gbos




                                                                                         1

Motion:
      GBOS moves to approve suggested amendments to Section II, Article 1 as recommended, with the addition of Girdwood Area
        Plan and Turnagain Arm Management Plan to links.
        Motion by KO/2nd NC
        Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

         Original motion to approve as recommended was amended to add in the GAP and Turnagain Arm Management Plan.
       Amendment by AT/KO and accepted by GBOS 4-1 (JW dissenting) in roll call vote.

         Motion:
      GBOS moves to approve changes to Section II, Article 2 as presented.
        Motion by KO/2nd NC
        Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

         Motion:
      GBOS moves to approve changes to Section II Article 3 as presented
        Motion by KO/2nd AT
        Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

         Motion:
      GBOS moves to approve changes to Section II, Articles 4 and 5 as presented.
        Motion by KO/2nd AT
        Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

        Motion
      GBOS moves to approve changes to Section II, Article 6A as presented.
        Motion by KO/2nd BB
        Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

         Motion:
      GBOS moves to approve changes to Section II, Article 6B-E as presented
        Motion by KO/2nd AT
        Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote.

         Motion:
      GBOS moves to approve changes to Section II, Articles 7 & 8 as presented.
        Motion by KO/NC
        Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

Motion to extend meeting 10 minutes to address item #2.     KO/NC         Motion carries

    2. GVSA Non-Profit Grants
       Review of timeline/Decision on late application
      One application was received after the deadline.

         Motion:
      GBOS moves to consider only grant applications that were received by the deadline of Sept 18 3PM.
        Motion by KO/2nd NC
        Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

GBOS continues Rules and Procedures discussion after completing item #2.
Motion to extend meeting to 2:30                      NC/BB          motion carries

         Motion:
      GBOS moves to Approve changes to Section II, Article 9 as presented, removing specific months.
        Motion by KO/2nd BB
        Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

         Motion:
      GBOS moves to move item in Section II, Article 10 to become an attachment (Attachment 3) to the Rules and Procedures.
        Motion by AT/2nd NC
        Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

GBOS moves to extend meeting to 2:40PM

                                                                                         2

Motion:
      GBOS moves to approve Article 11 as modified with addition of item F and renaming topic to include testimony of GBOS
       members.
        Motion by KO/AT
        Motion fails by roll call vote (2 in favor: NC and JW; 3 opposed: KO, BB, AT)

       Group agrees to schedule a follow up meeting to complete the Rules and procedures in a Special Meeting to be scheduled
        before the next GBOS meeting.

Adjourn 2:40PM
